equation: dX(t) = theta * (mu - X(t)) * dt + sigma * dW(t)
diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = 0  (g(X) = sigma is constant, additive noise)
implementation_notes: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reverting process with additive (constant) noise. Drift f(X) = theta*(mu - X) is linear in X; diffusion g = sigma is constant, so noise_structure is additive and Milstein is not eligible (correction term is 0). Use Euler-Maruyama. At T=1, exact mean = mu + (X_0-mu)*exp(-theta) = 2.0*exp(-1.5) ~ 0.446 (well above near_zero_mean_threshold, so the mean relative-error check applies). Exact variance = sigma^2/(2*theta)*(1 - exp(-2*theta)) ~ 0.0791.
